name: Whispers of the Citadel
source:
In the heart of the enchanting world of Halverth, where the emerald forests sway in the gentle breeze and ancient secrets whisper through the leaves, you find yourself thrust into a whirlwind of power, passion, and the pursuit of true love. As a valiant human soldier who has won the coveted Emeraldspire Citadel from the elves, you're destined for greatness, but fate has a different plan.

With the untimely death of the king, the kingdom teeters on the precipice of uncertainty. You stand as a prominent contender to the throne, yet your lack of a suitable spouse threatens to shatter your dreams. The nobles demand an heir, and you have just one month to find your perfect bride.

In [b]Whispers of the Citadel[/b], a thrilling adult visual novel, embark on a quest to secure not only your kingdom's future but your heart's deepest desires. Within this alluring world, you'll encounter five captivating love interests, each with their own unique allure and a tale waiting to be unraveled.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2670700/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在哈尔沃斯迷人的世界中心，翠绿的森林在微风中摇曳，古老的秘密在树叶间低语，你会发现自己被卷入了一股力量、激情和对真爱的追求的旋风中。作为一名英勇的人类士兵，从精灵手中赢得了令人垂涎的翡翠尖顶城堡，你注定会取得伟大的成就，但命运却有不同的计划。

随着国王的英年早逝，王国在不确定的悬崖上摇摇欲坠。你是王位的有力竞争者，但你缺乏合适的配偶，你的梦想可能会破灭。贵族需要一位继承人，而你只有一个月的时间来找到你的完美新娘。

在《[b] Citadel[/b]》这部惊心动魄的成人视觉小说中，你不仅要踏上旅程，不仅要确保王国的未来，还要确保内心最深处的渴望。在这个迷人的世界中，你将遇到五位迷人的爱情对象，每一位都有自己独特的魅力和等待解开的故事。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2670700/]Steam[/url]]
